name: Keenable

env_keys.comment: API keys and configuration variables documented by the provider.

python_extra.comment: HTTP API only; no required vendor Python SDK.

requires_key.comment: Valid API key required for every request.

snippet.comment: `description` and `snippet` per result; `snippet_max_length` controls the snippet cap.

domains.comment: `site` restricts results to one domain. There is no exclude-domain parameter.

content.comment: Search returns snippets only; full page markdown comes from the separate `/v1/fetch` endpoint.

highlights.comment: The single `snippet` string carries query-relevant highlights; there is no separate highlights array.

mode.comment: `mode=realtime` maps to fast and `mode=pro` (the default) maps to balanced. There is no separate deep tier; anysearch maps deep to pro.

pricing_per_1k.value: $4 / 1K pay-as-you-go; $1 / 1K at 100 RPS+ dedicated; 100,000 requests/month free
pricing_per_1k.comment: Units and commitments differ; do not rank these as equivalent flat per-query prices.

primary_price.basis: Published $4 per 1,000 requests; 100,000 free requests per month

lowest_price.basis: $1 per 1,000 at 100 RPS+ with cloud or on-premises; standard pay-as-you-go is $4

free_tier_limits.value: 100,000 requests/month free; resets monthly; no card
free_tier_limits.comment: Trial, monthly credits and model-tool promotions are distinct.

p50_latency.value: Historical July 2026: No published p50/p90/p95 API latency
p50_latency.comment: Historical evidence retained from July 2026; not remeasured or claimed current. Keenable documents modes, not percentile latency; no independent rerun was found.

notes: Search API (`POST /v1/search`) is in both SDKs. `mode=fast` uses the realtime SKU and `balanced`/`deep` use pro; only one include domain maps to `site`, and full page text requires Keenable's separate Fetch API.

native_api.value: POST /v1/search returns ranked title, URL, description, snippet, published_at and acquired_at fields. `mode` selects pro (deeper retrieval, default) or realtime; supports a single `site`, published and acquired date bounds, point-in-time `query_time`, max_results 1-50 and snippet length. Separate /v1/fetch returns page markdown.

rate_limits.value: 10 requests/s authenticated per organization; keyless 1,000/hour and 10/s per IP; HTTP 402 when the monthly allowance and purchased credits are exhausted

checked_at.comment: Official public documentation reviewed; no paid API or benchmark run.

capability_basis.comment: SDK availability is separate from native provider capability. Each native feature cell carries its own checked date and evidence.

sdk_support.comment: SDK adapter availability only. See Capability basis for the feature rows; native features do not imply an SDK adapter.
